4Read Aslı’s text. Mark T or F and correct the false statements.

I am Aslı. My close friend is Zeynep. We met at a summer art course two years ago, and now we attend different schools. We meet at the library every Saturday. Zeynep is understanding and reliable. She listens to my worries and keeps her promises. We have some different interests. She enjoys baking, but I prefer drawing to cooking. We both like documentaries about animals. Last week, I forgot our meeting because I had a family problem. Zeynep was not angry. She called to ask if I needed help. We sometimes disagree about films, but we respect each other’s ideas. A good friend makes you feel safe and valued.

6Match each invitation or question with a suitable response. One is extra.

Questions

  1. 1

    Would you like to join our picnic on Sunday?

  2. 2

    Shall we visit the museum after school?

  3. 3

    Would you like another cookie?

  4. 4

    How about playing volleyball at four?

  5. 5

    Do you have plans for Friday evening?

Replies

  • a) The tickets are blue.
  • b) No, I am free. What do you have in mind?
  • c) I am afraid I cannot. The museum closes before our lessons end.
  • d) No, thank you. I have already had three.
  • e) Sure. I will meet you at the sports centre.
  • f) That sounds lovely. What should I bring?

Extra: a
